signature: INTEGER          FUNCTION IZMAX1( N, ZX, INCX )

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of elements in the vector `ZX`.

params.name: x
params.reference: The vector `ZX`. The IZMAX1 function returns the index of its first element of maximum absolute value.

params.name: incx
params.reference: The spacing between successive values of `ZX`. $\mathrm{INCX} \ge 1$.
